scope: Line-by-line review of the frozen 2026-10-25T05:12:25Z deployed snapshot, the two failed publisher runs behind the freeze, the three Hotspawn fixtures added after that snapshot, and HLTV-first + esportsbook/exchange research for every fixture the featured method cannot resolve.
method: Full local regression suite (1753 tests) against main at 75d75a3; live Hotspawn fixtures API vs deployed snapshot diff; first-hand HLTV, Polymarket Gamma and EGamersWorld reads for the six gap fixtures; independent replay in scripts/0db056f7_verify.py.

items.area: Publisher frozen since 05:12Z — stale regression test pins live fixture state
items.finding: pages.yml runs 40174233578 (07:49Z) and 40196457503 (13:11Z) failed at 'Regression tests'; republish-last-verified succeeded so the live site kept serving the 2026-10-25T05:12:25Z build past the 8-hour staleness bound. Root cause reproduced locally (1 failure in 1753 tests): tests/test_b72154e1_guided_picks.py::test_group_a_are_snapshot_unresolved asserted fixture 1082858 pick_index is None against mutable snapshot.json, but the 05:12Z publisher snapshot resolved 1082858 via Polymarket (0.25/0.75, pick_index 1). The sibling Group B/C tests were already guarded against this exact trap after runs 40085158851/40116915898; Group A was missed.
items.handling: Guarded the pinned assertion to the dossier-named snapshot (2026-10-23T20:10:00Z) and added always-on invariants (team identity vs dossier; any graduated pick must be a two-number pair summing to 1 with a non-tie argmax). Verified: the module passes against the 05:12Z snapshot. No product code changed; no probability was touched.

items.area: 1082792 network-model estimate 98.2% is extreme for a LAN BO3
items.finding: HOTU vs The Huns (2026-10-31T09:00Z) publishes a bo3.gg network estimate of 98.2% HOTU. HLTV 2399437 confirms the fixture and the official event site lists HOTU #27 vs The Huns Esports #152, but no bookmaker/exchange prices it compliantly today (EGW 1.8 placeholder; Polymarket book non-compliant at the last publisher read), so the magnitude is an uncalibrated model output, not a market price.
items.handling: Left the published number untouched (probabilities are never hand-edited) and flagged here + in gap-research.md: treat direction as model-supported, magnitude as unreliable. The The Huns Esports -> The Huns alias is already wired, so a compliant Polymarket/book line will replace the model automatically on a later 4-hourly run.

items.area: Sandbox/runner egress limits shape how EGW evidence can enter
items.finding: The sandbox cannot reach Hotspawn/HLTV/Polymarket/EGW directly (curl returns 000) and GitHub Actions receives HTTP 403 from egamersworld.com, so EGW can never be a live runner source; it only enters as dated, SHA-256-checked manual captures with an 8-hour freshness gate (scripts/reference_odds.py).
items.handling: All live reads this session were first-hand fetches of the original pages/APIs through the browser-fetch tool; the one usable EGW quote was captured with its verbatim sentence + hash and replays through the shipped ladder. Placeholder pages (1.8/1.8, $0 stubs) were recorded as no-line, never as prices.
